intent: Each research-repo template under refTemplates/15_Research_Repo_Templates runs its own siloed Proposal → Delphi → cycle stovepipe for independent outcome comparison of validated outputs, feature extractions, and consensus implementations. No cross-silo score leakage.

baseline_cycle.name: RFP{1st_improve_request_cycle on RFP itself}→Delphi→cycle
stages: RFP (improve-request on the RFP schema / surface itself)

evolutionary_extension.name: feature 🧬 evolutionary selections & mixes
evolutionary_extension.note: After baseline silo comparison, each silo may spawn variant RFPs (rnd / selected / control) for evolutionary feature mixes. Variant token is exactly "selected" everywhere (silos, docs, surface_id suffix). Attribution remains per-silo + variant.

expected_independent_results.attribution: one result stream per research silo (slot)
expected_independent_results.with_evolutionary: 12 × (1 + N_variants); N starts at 3 (rnd, selected, control) → up to 48 independent streams when fully extended
expected_independent_results.current_schema_note: Delphi Oracle RFP gate currently scores free-tier surfaces (ops/delphi/surfaces.json). Research silos are parallel metadata + RFP lanes that reuse the same gate, panel, and flywheel; each silo files its own delphi:rfp with surface_id = research.<slot>.

silos.note: surface_id is lowercased on purpose: gate.py _SURF_RE (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$) silently drops uppercase ids from flywheel/tribute signals. Slot and path keep upstream case.
metadata-only; do not run upstream installer

rules: One RFP per silo for the baseline improve-cycle; surface_id must match silo.id
No shared score aggregation across silos; comparison is post-hoc on ledger outcomes
Validated outputs, feature extractions, and consensus impls are recorded in the RFP ledger comment + delphi:outcomes
Evolutionary variants append .rnd | .selected | .control to the silo id
Dual-gate + evidence-led still govern any live pin under refTemplates/smods/
Reuse existing panel.json roles, gate.py, and flywheel; do not fork the scoring engine

gate_filing.lane: other (the form has no research option; do not invent one)
gate_filing.scoring_posture: research.* ids are NOT in ops/delphi/surfaces.json (18 surfaces, verified 2026-10-27), so gate.surface_from_issue builds a synthetic surface: sourced=false, fit=3, headroom=3, horizon=H2. The gate score is an admission rubric only; the research comparison axes (validated outputs / feature extractions / consensus implementation) are NOT gate-scored - they are recorded post-hoc in the RFP ledger + delphi:outcomes, per rules.
gate_filing.free_quota_field: none - research template validation lane; no quota surface (evidence: slot SOURCE.txt + path)
gate_filing.reset_and_zone_field: none - no quota reset; parked recheck per panel.json award defaults (medium 14d / backlog 30d)
gate_filing.veto_trap: gate.surface_from_issue sets card_required by substring search over the free_quota + failure_modes form text for the word denoting a payment instrument; any occurrence (even a negation) triggers the cost_auditor money veto (score capped at 4). Keep that word out of both fields for research RFPs.
gate_filing.title_regex_note: gate title fallback regex is lowercase-only ([a-z0-9._-]); always file via the surface_id form field, never rely on title parsing.
